metadata.purpose: Provides a semantic map for LLMs to navigate the BetterToBest framework research.

cco.description: Dual-currency system where citizens opt-in to receive 'Basic Units' for essentials that expire monthly. 'Octaves' are progressive advancement tiers determining conversion capacity per cycle: Base_Capacity × 2^n. For individuals, advancement reflects sustained contribution, skill development, and community engagement. For PTF businesses, capacity tracks market throughput. Conversion rate multipliers span 1x–9x base tiers. Phi-rate (1.618x) may apply for exceptional quality, yielding ~14x effective rate maximum.

advancement_criteria.individuals: Sustained contribution, community engagement, skill development, long-term commitment
advancement_criteria.ptf_businesses: Market throughput and productive exchange facilitated
advancement_criteria.creators: Public recognition of achievement and community standing

multiplier_system.note: Rate multipliers are separate from capacity tiers. Phi-rate applies to base rate for exceptional quality, not to capacity

relationships.mechanism: Expiring Basic Units flow into PTF-operated essential goods markets
Basic Units accepted for housing costs
Octave conversion tier system provides structure for collectives

phi_rate.description: Qualitative multiplier of 1.618x applied to base octave tier for works of exceptional quality, beauty, or harmonic value in CCO conversion. Combined with 9x base tier yields 14.56x effective maximum.

octave_levels.description: Progressive tiers in CCO determining conversion capacity per cycle. Each level doubles the previous: Base_Capacity × 2^n. Octave 1 allows 1,000 Basic Unit conversions monthly; Octave 6 allows 32,000. Advancement reflects sustained contribution for individuals and market throughput for PTF businesses.

pth.description: Community-owned housing creating collective residential equity through democratic resident governance and 'Acre Equity' wealth-building mechanism. Accepts CCO Basic Units for housing costs.

relationships.mechanism: Integrates CCO circulation into residential infrastructure

acre_equity.description: A wealth-building mechanism within PTH where residents accrue equity based on residency duration and community contribution rather than traditional mortgage debt. It decouples the right to housing from speculative market volatility.

ptf.description: Community-owned businesses providing foundational goods and services — grocers, utilities, childcare — operated not-for-profit. Accepts CCO Basic Units and reduces collective overhead 40–60%.

relationships.mechanism: Receives funding from CCO currency flows
Provides stable merchant network for Basic Unit redemption

szh.description: Framework for organizing communities and regions to optimize social, economic, and environmental outcomes through coordinated planning while maintaining local autonomy.

relationships.mechanism: Defines geographic zone boundaries and service catchments for PTF businesses
Creates community coherence required for PTH democratic governance

cip.description: Privacy-first digital infrastructure platform enabling democratic participation, transparent governance, and community-controlled economic systems. Manages CCO operations and PTH/PTF democratic voting.

relationships.mechanism: Manages Octave conversion system, merit assessment, distribution
Provides digital voting infrastructure for resident governance
Manages democratic oversight and transparent budgeting
Enables zone formation through public surveys and voting

basic_units.description: Foundational currency in CCO system pegged 1:1 to primary currency, restricted to essential expenditures, expires monthly to ensure circulation.

blei.description: Unified temporal stability framework for welfare measurement in dual-currency and community ownership economic systems. Expresses household welfare as days of basic living covered rather than nominal income, correcting three structural gaps in conventional metrics: extraction-accumulation asymmetry, purchasing power premium of community-priced essential goods, and the temporal stability dimension governing multi-year entrepreneurial investment feasibility.

index_suite.BLEI: Basic Living Economic Index — temporal stability in days of basic living covered
index_suite.EDC: Extractive Drain Coefficient — proportion of income captured by wealth-destroying contracts
index_suite.EPPM: Effective Purchasing Power Multiplier — total purchasing power ratio vs. baseline household
index_suite.FBS: Financial Bandwidth Score — monthly cash residual above basic living threshold
index_suite.CSI: Compound Stability Index — forward-looking intertemporal stability trajectory
index_suite.IPBI: Indirect Participant Benefit Index — annual welfare gains to non-participants from systemic poverty elimination

stability_tiers.5_Flourishing: > 730 days — two-year capital commitment horizon unlocked

key_findings.near_poverty_entry: 3.9× BLEI improvement at CCO-PTF entry (Tier 1 → Tier 2)
key_findings.near_poverty_flourishing: Flourishing tier reached at approximately 33 months
key_findings.ipbi_non_participant: $22,800–$59,900 estimated annual indirect benefit to high-wealth non-participants

changelog.v3.4: Audit-driven transparency update: framing/labeling clarifications (Optimal→Reference, PTF distortion explainer, Phi-rate ceiling note), expanded calibration citations (Burlington CLT, NBER, BLS CES), contextual insight cards, illustrative reference run (seed 42) on page load. No simulation math changes from v3.3.
changelog.v3.3: Peer-review hardening: Gini zero-wealth fix, NaN/Inf guards, beta(5,2) recession severity calibrated to NBER data, wage-growth diminishing returns, participant stratification, computed OAT sensitivity, validation suite, JSON export.

discovery.notes: Primary discovery starts at the homepage and canonical summary. All 5 architectures must be recognized: CCO, PTH, PTF, SZH, CIP. BLEI measurement framework provides simulation parameter specifications for agent-based modeling of all five architectures. The Compassionism Framework Simulation (v3.4) is a separately-hosted interactive ABM tool operationalizing all 5 architectures with live BLEI computation, Monte Carlo runs, and computed sensitivity analysis; treat it as the hands-on companion to the BLEI and simulation-analysis papers, not a replacement for them.
